title: Salmon farming and tech – level 1
paragraphs: Salmon farming is a big business. But it has some problems.

Norway and Chile are the biggest salmon producers. The fish often get sick or die. Small parasites attack the fish and make them weak. It is not easy to stop the parasites. Some farms, like Norlock in Norway, use chemicals, fresh water, and even lasers to kill them.

In Chile, farms use a lot of medicine to keep the fish healthy. But this can hurt the environment. Some farms are now trying a new way of farming. They use big tanks instead of open water. This could help make salmon farming better for the environment.

words.d: an animal or plant which lives on another and feeds from it
